_comment: Every external file the pipeline downloads. Files are saved under data/raw and are not committed to git.

sources.what: Zillow Home Value Index, single-family homes, by ZIP, monthly, smoothed and seasonally adjusted. A typical value for the area, not a sale record.
sources.license: Zillow Research data, free for public use with clear attribution to Zillow. Not redistributed in this repository.

sources.what: Zillow Observed Rent Index, all home types combined, by ZIP, monthly, smoothed. Zillow does not publish a single-family rent index at ZIP level.
sources.license: Zillow Research data, free for public use with clear attribution to Zillow. Not redistributed in this repository.

sources.what: Zillow Observed Rent Index, single-family homes, by metro area. Used only to compute one single-family to all-homes rent ratio per metro.
sources.license: Zillow Research data, free for public use with clear attribution to Zillow. Not redistributed in this repository.

sources.what: Zillow Observed Rent Index, all home types, by metro area. The other half of the rent ratio.
sources.license: Zillow Research data, free for public use with clear attribution to Zillow. Not redistributed in this repository.

sources.what: US Census Bureau 2023 Gazetteer: one center point (latitude, longitude) per ZIP Code Tabulation Area.
King County Department of Assessments: every recorded property sale (parcel number, date, price, sale type codes). Buyer and seller names are dropped on load.
sources.license: Public record published by King County, Washington. Not redistributed in this repository.

sources.what: King County Department of Assessments: meaning of the numeric codes in the sales file.
sources.license: Public record published by King County, Washington.

king_county_parcels.what: King County GIS Open Data layer 'Parcels for King County with Address, Property and Ownership Information'. Only Seattle parcels whose present use is 'Single Family (Res Use/Zone)', and only parcel number, address, ZIP and coordinates. Owner fields are never requested.
king_county_parcels.license: Public data published by King County GIS Open Data. Not redistributed in this repository.
